RimHex.HexAugmentDef.label: Hive Mind
RimHex.HexAugmentDef.description: Every 200 actual direct damage summons a crystal drone, at most once per 5 seconds. Each stack adds 9.75% summon damage. Teaches Drone Call. Draft limit: 4 stacks.

RimHex.HexAugmentDef.label: Minionmancer
RimHex.HexAugmentDef.description: Each stack adds 32.5% to summon health and damage inheritance multipliers. Teaches Drone Call. Draft limit: 4 stacks.

RimHex.HexAugmentDef.label: Hand of Baron
RimHex.HexAugmentDef.description: Each stack grants 13% personal damage and adds 19.5% to the summon damage inheritance multiplier. Teaches Drone Call. Draft limit: 4 stacks.

RimHex.HexAugmentDef.label: Mirror Image
RimHex.HexAugmentDef.description: Taking hostile direct damage at or below 35% health summons two combat echoes, once per 30 seconds. Each stack adds 16.25% to echo damage inheritance. Echoes grant no invisibility and copy no equipment or work skills. Teaches Echo Projection. Draft limit: 4 stacks.

RimHex.HexAugmentDef.label: Trickster Demon
RimHex.HexAugmentDef.description: A destroyed echo strikes up to eight enemies within 4 cells for 22.75 base secondary damage per stack. Natural expiry causes no blast. Teaches Echo Projection. Draft limit: 4 stacks.

RimHex.HexAugmentDef.label: DropBear
RimHex.HexAugmentDef.description: Death leaves a crystal bear for 20 seconds. Each stack adds 32.5% to its damage inheritance multiplier. Once per colonist per day. Draft limit: 4 stacks.

RimHex.HexAugmentDef.label: Hellbent
RimHex.HexAugmentDef.description: Forty eligible direct hits charge one rescue, counting at most once per 0.5 seconds. A lethal injury spends the charge to heal recoverable injuries; a successful rescue protects from direct damage for 1.3 seconds. 150-second cooldown. Missing organs, disease and execution are not prevented.

RimHex.HexAugmentDef.label: Serve Beyond Death
RimHex.HexAugmentDef.description: Taking hostile direct damage at or below 35% health grants 8 seconds of borrowed life: 32.5% damage and 26 base healing per stack, plus 2 seconds of direct-damage protection. Personally killing an eligible enemy settles the debt; otherwise suffer a 10-second stun. 60-second cooldown. Does not resurrect the dead. Draft limit: 4 stacks.

RimHex.HexAugmentDef.label: Dawnbringer's Resolve
RimHex.HexAugmentDef.description: Taking hostile direct damage at or below 35% health grants five once-per-second heals, each restoring 6.5 base health per stack. 30-second cooldown. Draft limit: 4 stacks.

RimHex.HexAugmentDef.label: Escape Plan
RimHex.HexAugmentDef.description: Taking hostile direct damage at or below 35% health grants 29.25 base shield and 39% movement speed per stack for 5 seconds. 30-second cooldown. Draft limit: 4 stacks.

RimHex.HexAugmentDef.label: Divine Intervention
RimHex.HexAugmentDef.description: Teaches Sanctuary Ring: protect yourself and visible colonists within 5 cells from direct damage for 1 second. Base cooldown: 30 seconds. Disease, missing organs and deferred injury debts still apply.

RimHex.HexAugmentDef.label: Vengeance
RimHex.HexAugmentDef.description: A player humanlike colonist downed or killed within 18 cells grants 39% damage per stack for 10 seconds, at most once per 10 seconds. Summons do not trigger it. Draft limit: 4 stacks.
